stories.story_fr: Les ventes neuves japonaises bondissent de 25,5% au Q1 2026, tirees par le triple lancement Anshin Palette (medical), Miraito (cancer) et Tsumitasu (vie), preuve que le moteur produit du troisieme secteur se reanime.
stories.story_en: Japan new sales jumped 25.5% in Q1 2026, driven by the triple launch of Anshin Palette (medical), Miraito (cancer) and Tsumitasu (life), showing the third-sector product engine is reaccelerating.
stories.quote: For the quarter, total new annualized premium sales (sales) increased 25.5% to ¥17.7 billion, or $113 million, primarily reflecting strong sales of Anshin Palette, the new medical insurance product launched in December, as well as Miraito, the newest cancer insurance product, and Tsumitasu

stories.story_fr: Aflac fete 43 annees consecutives de hausse du dividende et releve encore le versement de 5,2% au Q1 2026, un ancrage de retour aux actionnaires que peu d'assureurs egalent.
stories.story_en: Aflac marks 43 consecutive years of dividend increases and again raised the payout 5.2% in Q1 2026, a shareholder-return anchor few insurers match.
stories.quote: We treasure our 2025 milestone of 43 consecutive years of dividend increases, and the Board has set us on a path to extend this record when it increased the first quarter dividend 5.2% and declared the same dividend of $0.61 for the second quarter

stories.story_fr: Au Q3 2025 la marge avant impot du segment Japon a atteint 52,2% contre 44,7% un an plus tot, dopee par des gains de remesure de reserves issus du desannualisation des hypotheses.
stories.story_en: In Q3 2025 the Japan pretax margin hit 52.2% versus 44.7% a year earlier, lifted by reserve remeasurement gains from unlocking assumptions.
stories.quote: Pretax adjusted earnings in yen for the quarter increased 13.1% on a reported basis to ¥179.5 billion, primarily due to lower benefits from higher reserve remeasurement gains as a result of unlocking assumptions. The pretax adjusted profit margin for the Japan segment was 52.2%, compared with 44.7% a year ago

stories.story_fr: Aux Etats-Unis, les produits de groupe volontaire (vie, invalidite, dentaire et vision en reseau) portent les ventes a un pic de 551 M$ au Q4 2025, confirmant la montee en gamme du canal collectif.
stories.story_en: In the U.S., group voluntary products (life, disability, network dental and vision) pushed sales to a $551M peak in Q4 2025, confirming the build-out of the group channel.
stories.quote: Aflac U.S. sales increased 3.1% in the quarter to $551 million, primarily benefiting from sales of group voluntary products
